contracts: (Attempt staging 不再可发布或读取为 ready，且仅该 Attempt 路径被处置。) AND (The exact directory-switch selector is discovered and passes with nonzero assertions.) AND (The restore selector executes against retained content and asserts restored output without caller-path authority.) AND (The targeted RestoreBoundaryTests P95 selector is discovered, executes with multiple documented samples, verifies derivation and bound, and is non-skipped.) AND (The targeted RestoreBoundaryTests selector is discovered, executes ownership and ACL assertions, and is non-skipped.) AND (The targeted RestoreBoundaryTests selector is discovered, executes the readback assertion, and is non-skipped.) AND (The targeted RestoreBoundaryTests timing selector is discovered, runs against a bounded fixture, and is non-skipped.) AND (The targeted directory-switch failure test is discovered and asserts exactly-one-ready-or-typed-repair outcome.) AND (The targeted metadata-commit failure test is discovered and asserts exactly-one-ready-or-typed-repair outcome.) AND (The targeted metadata-commit failure test is discovered and verifies absence of partial Workspace content.) AND (仅当六类夹具均存在且内容校验通过时才发布 ready Workspace。) AND (旧 ready Workspace 内容哈希、状态和读回均与处置前一致，且未指向 staging。)
selector_intents: PhaseB.Repair.RestoreBoundaryTests directory-switch failure selector fails if partial Workspace content is observable.
RestoreBoundaryTests 取消或失败用例检测到 Attempt-owned staging 仍可作为 ready Workspace 读取时应失败。
RestoreBoundaryTests 比较处置前后旧 ready Workspace 的哈希、状态或可读性发生变化时应失败。
Run the bounded-RTO selector and fail when P95 is not sample-derived, approval time is included, or P95 exceeds 30 minutes.
Run the restore selector and fail when restoration bypasses the local storage contract, lacks logical identifiers, or uses a caller-controlled host path.
Run the stage-timing selector and fail when required stages are missing or timing stops before controlled Run completion.
Run the substitute-root drill ownership/ACL selector and fail when either validation result is absent.
Run the substitute-root readback selector and fail when readback is not executed or its result is absent.
验证 Restore 在缺失任一 GDD/module/source/test/plan/artifact 类别或内容校验失败时拒绝成功状态。
